last_completed_unit.finding: The official Cargo Build Scripts page documents build.rs as a separately compiled executable that Cargo runs and that may perform any number of tasks. Combined with the prior role-local verified Cargo --offline scope, this does not justify treating --offline as a network sandbox for build scripts or other spawned build-time tools. A dependency with an executed build script therefore retains a hidden-network-side-effect blocker unless separately eliminated, constrained, or proven network-free.
last_completed_unit.verified_scope: Reject only the inference that Cargo --offline alone proves build-script network isolation; do not claim that every build script actually uses the network.
last_completed_unit.not_verified_scope: Per-script network behavior, OS sandboxing, universal build-script elimination, actual Chat-native Cargo/rustc execution, end-to-end richer-mode parity.

source_scope: Current required repository controls for open_source, current own LATEST, SHA-only note-main identity, and exactly one official Cargo documentation page: https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/build-scripts.html.
scope_guard: Do not broaden absence of a documented --offline subprocess sandbox guarantee into a claim that every build script has network access or performs network I/O.

frontier.current_target: Determine whether Cargo-native configuration can eliminate or override build scripts sufficiently to remove the hidden subprocess-network blocker for a bounded dependency class.
frontier.next_unit: After fresh required-control bootstrap and SHA-only freshness validation, inspect exactly one official Cargo/Rust documentation page or section about disabling/overriding build scripts. Test only whether the mechanism can prevent build.rs execution for a clearly bounded package class without introducing hosted compute, paid quota, user execution, or broader semantic claims.
